meta.title: Scholar digest
meta.description: Closes the gap in batch-searching CNKI literature with an agent: the academic research preset reads CNKI Space metadata, maps each link to the openable kns.cnki.net page server-side, and adds arXiv, PubMed and Semantic Scholar for English literature; the download-paper skill packages a topic into an offline HTML index, XLSX table, BibTeX, RIS and an arXiv download script.
